question: 2026年下半年的订单数量是上半年订单数量的几倍？（保留两位小数）
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-07-01') * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date <= '2026-06-30'), 2) AS h2_to_h1_ratio
pred_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) BETWEEN '07' AND '12' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) BETWEEN '01' AND '06' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS times FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2026' AND status != 'cancelled'
